preconditions: Redis 8.0.1 .. 8.10.1 built with the default Vector Sets module (INCLUDE_VEC_SETS=1, auto-loaded at startup)
an authenticated client able to VADD/VSETATTR an element with a crafted deeply-nested JSON attribute and then run VSIM ... FILTER

evidence.observed_result: Compiling the verbatim modules/vector-sets/{expr,fastjson}.c (vulnerable tree src/ = Redis <=8.10.1, fixed tree src-fixed/ = 8.10.2) and driving exprRun('.f', {"f":[[[[...]]]]}): the vulnerable parser recurses jsonParseArrayToken<->jsonParseValueToken once per '[' with no depth cap and dies with SIGSEGV (rc 139) at ~100k nesting (600 KB attribute used in the PoC); the fixed 8.10.2 parser (commit 52194c8 'Limit Vector Sets JSON Parser Allowed Recursion Depth', MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH_LIMIT=1000) rejects the same input cleanly (exprRun returns 0, no crash). Matches Redis 8.10.2 release note 'Vector Sets: Deeply nested JSON used in Vector Set queries could cause the server to crash'. In redis-server the same path (VSIM FILTER -> vectorSetFilterCallback -> exprRun) crashes the whole process.
